{{Short description|German mathematician}}
[[File:Reinhold Remmert.jpg|thumb|Reinhold Remmert]]  
'''Reinhold W. Remmert''' (22 June 1930 – 9 March 2016<ref>[https://www.uni-muenster.de/FB10/historie/Remmert.pdf Prof. Dr. Reinhold Remmert]</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mfo.de/|title=MFO|website=MFO|accessdate=17 December 2021}}</ref>) was a German [[mathematician]]. Born in [[Osnabrück]], [[Lower Saxony]], he studied [[mathematics]], [[mathematical logic]] and [[physics]] in [[University of Münster|Münster]]. He established and developed the theory of [[complex-analytic space]]s in joint work with [[Hans Grauert]]. Until his retirement in 1995, he was a professor for [[complex analysis]] in [[University of Münster|Münster]].

Remmert wrote two books on [[number theory]] and [[complex analysis]], which contain a huge amount of historical information together with references on important papers in the subject.
